title: Numerators are off by one
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  `ClaimCore` constructor will set the numerators (`numeratorUsdc`, `numeratorUsdt`, `numeratorNative`) for computing the required donation amount to claim the ZRO token.  However, the numerators are off by a factor of 10 as the base10 exponent is incorrectly subtracted by 1 during initialization.
